semantic.justification: Ports the bounded slot, item-argument, completion, and return-item request contract while exposing browser payloads only at the adapter boundary. Iteration109 carries explicit unsigned UNO KeyModifier metadata separately from slot arguments to zero-default SfxRequest and document-owned paragraph StyleApply. Only native KEY_MOD1 triggers initial full-character/list reset. The existing content-manager owner constructs the registered native deletion set excluding list83..87; docfmt uses selective node reset with protected nonempty numbering/page/non-NONE break and Ctrl repeated-list eligibility. txtedt removes common automatic-style items while retaining unrelated items, exact flags and internet hints. Collection history owns hints before initial selective reset; the separate exact-reset owner captures after collection processing. Native redo retains list eligibility but omits the initial full-character flag and uses default non-exact hint reset, including repeated-style level asymmetry. Actual request/core/frame/mounted UI/ODT tests cover mask literals, filtering, ordinary/URL separation, protected defaults, inclusive empty/end-zero spans, untouched neighbors, partial/whole hints, history ownership, three cycles and continued input/export. Every prior test is byte-identical. Language/direction/fields/marks/layout/redlines/rings/inline headings, full UNO transforms/style families/native defaults/history and complete UI parity remain unverified; no status/default/exception promotion or registered save/open/recovery change. Older missing-modifier/deletion-set claims are superseded only for this bounded registered operation. TaskRV75WR implements native1280twip compressed column widths,source FilterData hidden runs,geometry-only document copies,marked/grouped direct/show/hide commands and real ScUndoWidthOrHeight documents. ColumnWidth26290 uses typed UInt16 HMM and optional one-based FN_PARAM_1;the actual metric dialog normalizes two decimals in the configured CM/INCH unit,preserves default/current toggling,and records a separate completed even-HMM request. Shared SfxRequest now separates cloned SetReturnValue from Done and implements source call-mode flags/AppendItem/removal;both common dispatch adapters and the actual Writer style caller use that contract. React reuses shared Writer menus/dialog styling and reads actual native column geometry with bounded scrolling and hidden-column keyboard skipping. Independent ODS column style/repeat/visibility and genuine byte reopens preserve represented widths and cells. Full pool/recorder/UNO argument transforms,optimal widths,protection,merged/outline/drawing/alternate views,native widget/font/device services and complete application parity remain unverified. Existing primary saving/open/no-recovery policy remains.
